item.title: 2 Minute Medicine Rewind August 31, 2026
item.description: A study in Japan found that the in-hospital mortality rate for patients undergoing elective atrial fibrillation ablation was low, but certain factors increased risk.

item.title: Marriage and Medicine: Dual Physician Households
item.description: When both partners are doctors, managing call schedules and household duties can be tough, but having a spouse who understands the demands is beneficial.

item.title: Model IDs Adolescents with Cancer with High Acute Event Risk
item.description: A validated risk model can predict acute care events in adolescent and young adult cancer patients soon after treatment, according to a Medscape report.

item.title: Hidden immune cells in the lung could lead to better flu vaccines
item.description: Influenza causes over 35,000 deaths annually in the U.S., and new insights into lung immune cells may improve vaccine effectiveness.
